title: Accessing Facebook Business Live Support Chat
description: This is a semi-short tutorial on how to access a live agent chat on Facebook's business support site.    I walk you through step by step on the process to locate the site and avoid getting lost in their support navigation pages designed to keep you away from actually chatting with a person.  I do find their chat fairly helpful and have chatted in with them multiple times.  If you're having any issues with your facebook ads account or get your account disabled for no reason give them a quick chat and they might be able to help you out.    To access their chat go to https://www.facebook.com/business/help and click support, then click Get Started, and then choose a issue.  Once you do this you'll find their chat support option on the bottom.    Watch the video to be walked through the process.   If you like the video please like it and subscribe to my channel!   Take care!
